title: Paper Route · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Route · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws three dots and a start point on a sheet. The lead draws one continuous line from the start through all three dots. The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Route, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil.
